IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Committee on Finance (originally sponsored by Representatives Murray, Kristiansen, Dickerson, Clements, Chase, McDonald and Dunn)

Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain amounts received by nonprofit convention and tourism promotion corporations from business and occupation tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the business and occupation taxation of paymentsand contributions to nonprofit convention and tourism promotioncorporations by public entities; and adding a new section to chapter82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts received by a nonprofitcorporation organized under chapter 24.03 RCW as payments orcontributions from the state or any county, city, town, municipalcorporation, quasimunicipal corporation, port district, or publiccorporation for the promotion of conventions and tourism.
